answer: An apiary is the identity: eight tagged hives, one sealed scale chosen by the epoch seed, weighing the colony every fifteen minutes for three days. A genuine trace gains before noon and lightens as foragers evaporate water; flat lines fail, so do curves copied from a neighbour or blind to weather, since dune heath and linden orchard dry out differently. Shared sites or owners fold into one vote; forgery forfeits the $5,000 bond. A thousand clones need 8,000 hives at $420, near $3.4M, then a voyage from willow to aster. No two opals flash alike; a repeated curve reads as one beekeeper.
